card.name: Small words before a suspected cause
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'a', 'the' or 'consistent' that sit just before a noun the sentence is about to name. The clearest case is 'where a' before a corticosteroid in corneal ulcer text.

modes.label: Where a steroid has been used
modes.description: The word 'a' after 'where' in the repeated corneal ulceration warning, just before a steroid name.

modes.label: Other words before a noun
modes.description: A determiner or adjective in running text, just before a noun such as hypotheses or CRS.
modes.example: some of<< the>> hypotheses are speculative; and it is not

modes.label: Odd pieces of names and numbers
modes.description: Scattered cases inside a name or number, such as Baal or Abell 1689.
